chapter: The Beetle Battles Will Never End!
act_title: The Beetle Battles Will Never End!

quests.title: The Beetle Battles Will Never End!

dialogue.t: I see. I see... Let us battle once more. This time, I'll see through all of your methods.
Victory and defeat no longer seem so important... Let's just battle for fun, shall we?
It's rare that I should find such a great opponent. It would be a shame to end our battles so soon, would it not?
Sure! Bring it on!
But seeing through my secret beetle-fighting techniques? Nah, little fella, that ain't gonna happen!
If you'll admit that I'm the stronger beetle fighter, I'll fight you for as many rounds as you want!
Huh, looks like Bull-Chucker and Grandmaster Hanakado are still raring to go... Well, let's leave them to it! They can battle beetles till the beetle-battling's done!
Hahahahaha...
Astounding!
Hahahahaha...
Amazing!
Even though your fighting style differs greatly from mine, I resonate strongly with the passion you imbue into your Onikabuto.
In time, you shall surely become a true champion of the beetle-fighting world.
You're pretty good yourself! You managed to win an impressive 570 out of our 1,141 matches!
Of all the beetle-battle marathons I've fought in my time, you've lasted the longest by far! Not gonna lie, I'm impressed!
No, I won 571 rounds, so I'm ahead. Also, you have the home advantage. Taking that into account, it is in fact I who am the superior warrior.
Huh? Why you gotta be so stubborn? I remember our score clear as day, and Mamoru is our witness!
Ain't that right, Mamoru?
Boss, I... I really can't take it anymore... Please let me sleep for a while...
Uhh... Have they been going at it this whole time without a break!?
Have they been going at it without a break!?

dialogue.sit: The arena must be about to collapse...

dialogue.t: Fine! Since I'm a generous guy, I can give you one round, no problemo. I'll just defeat you next time!
And if you're still not convinced, we'll do the next battle on your home turf. I'll prove that it's about the beetle fighter, not the location!
That suits me just fine. Follow me.
Oh? Hey, compadre, Flying Lavender Melon, you're finally here!
Wait a minute, why's Paimon back to Flying Lavender Melon again? Does Paimon only get a good nickname when she's fighting for you?
Uh, never mind that for now! Here's your 2-month free ramen voucher, as agreed. Take it!
Ramen voucher? Oh yeah, right! The ramen!
Now that's more like it!

dialogue.sit: And the "Extreme Beetle Brawl" is a wrap!

dialogue.t: Oh, no, no, no, no. This was just the warmup. The Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl is still to come!
After all, things are way too quiet without an audience. We can't just end the event like this!
But the good news is, Grandmaster Hanakado finally let go of his pride and admitted that I'm a strong beetle fighter!
Still, we ain't done with each other just yet. I'll be heading to his home turf alone soon, where I'm gonna defeat him once and for all.
Once that happens, he'll have to follow my orders — and by that, I mean he'll help us make the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl the biggest, baddest event ever!
Thanks again to the two of you. Now, wait here — I'll be back with good news in no time at all!
Bull-Chucker sure seems like he's having fun, and we got two months' worth of ramen out of it, hee-hee!

dialogue.sit: Everyone's happy, that's all that matters.

dialogue.t: Boss, Boss! There's a letter from Shinobu. Take a look at this...
Huh? Where'd the Boss go? He was beetle fighting right here just a moment ago...
Uh, is it urgent? Because Bull-Chucker just left with Grandmaster Hanakado. They said they were going to continue their battle...
Well, it's not urgent, just a little unexpected...
You can read it for yourself if you want.
What the... So Grandmaster Hanakado is actually part of the Arataki Gang? But his... communication style made Bull-Chucker feel like he was facing a mortal enemy...
Just as Shinobu expected, Bull-Chucker is spending all his time beetle fighting without resting or eating.
But he did get us to organize the Beetle Brawl event for him...

dialogue.sit: I still wouldn't really call that resting, per se.

dialogue.t: Y'know, Paimon thinks Shinobu deserves to enjoy the ramen voucher more than we do! Why don't we take her for ramen when she gets back?
Hmm... Actually, wait a moment.
Bull-Chucker didn't tell us which ramen stall this voucher's meant to be used at...
...Are we supposed to find the store by ourselves!?

quests.description: The Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl appears to have been a great success, and it’s now time to return to the brawl grounds to check on Arataki Itto and Grandmaster Hanakado…
